problem_statement: In farideghbali/startup-website-template the single-page startup landing page has a hero, a "Main Features" section with six capability cards, a workflow/integrations section, "Simple and Affordable Pricing" cards with Start Free Trial buttons, a "Need Help? Open a Ticket" contact form, a Subscribe card, a footer, and a #change-mood dark-mode toggle. The six feature cards are a flat wall with no way to focus on the capabilities that matter to a given launch. Add a native "Feature focus" filter bar directly above the Main Features grid: a row of focus pills (All / Build / Design / Support) that filters the six cards by their focus area and shows a live result count readout in the form "Showing N of 6 · <Focus>". Tag each of the six existing cards with a focus area (Build, Design, or Support) so the counts are real (Build 3, Design 2, Support 1). Clicking a pill must re-filter the visible cards AND update the readout so the count always matches the cards shown; the initial state shows "Showing 6 of 6 · All features". Reuse the same feature-focus bar on a new secondary page feature-tour.html (manufactured from the site's own header/nav + Main Features markup) and register a "Feature Tour" entry in the shared header navigation, so the same "Feature focus" control renders on both the home page and the feature-tour page. The bar and grid must stay consistent with the existing Tailwind design system (blue #4a6cf7 primary action, dark-mode navy surfaces, pill controls, restrained accents), wrap cleanly with no horizontal overflow on mobile, and preserve every existing home-page section, the pricing cards, the contact form, the footer, and the theme toggle.
required_content: A "Feature focus" filter bar placed directly above the Main Features grid on the home page.
Four focus pills labelled All, Build, Design, and Support, each showing its card count.
A live readout in the form "Showing N of 6 · <Focus>" that starts at "Showing 6 of 6 · All features".
Each of the six existing feature cards tagged with a focus area (Build 3 / Design 2 / Support 1) via data-facet.
Clicking a focus pill re-filters the visible feature cards and updates the readout count to match.
A secondary feature-tour.html page that reuses the same feature-focus bar over the feature grid.
A "Feature Tour" entry in the shared header navigation linking feature-tour.html on both pages.
No horizontal overflow at mobile (390px) or tablet widths; the pill row wraps instead of overflowing.
All existing sections preserved: hero, pricing cards, Start Free Trial, contact ticket form, footer, dark-mode toggle.
design_constraints: Use the existing Tailwind design language: #4a6cf7 primary/action blue, dark-mode navy surfaces, rounded pill controls.
The feature-focus bar must sit inside the Main Features section, above the six-card grid (native placement, not a floating strip).
The pill row must wrap on narrow viewports (flex-wrap) so the document never overflows a 390px phone viewport.
The active focus pill must remain high-contrast and legible in both light and dark mode.
Filtered feature cards must keep the grid's normal responsive flow; hidden cards use display:none, no overlapping or clipping.
The same feature-focus bar and filter behaviour must appear on both index.html and feature-tour.html.
state_constraints: desktop_features captures the home Main Features section with the feature-focus bar (All/Build/Design/Support pills) above the six-card grid and the 'Showing 6 of 6 · All features' readout.
desktop_features_build captures the home feature grid after clicking the Build pill: the cards re-filter to the three Build features and the readout updates to 'Showing 3 of 6 · Build'.
desktop_tour captures the feature-tour page showing the same feature-focus bar reused over the feature grid, reached from the shared 'Feature Tour' nav entry.
mobile_features and tablet_home capture responsive states where the feature-focus pill row wraps with no horizontal overflow on narrow viewports.

change_completion: The feature-focus bar renders above the Main Features grid with All/Build/Design/Support pills and a live count.
Clicking a focus pill re-filters the cards and updates the readout to 'Showing N of 6 · <Focus>'.
design_consistency: The bar and pills reuse the #4a6cf7 blue, navy dark surfaces and pill styling of the existing template.
The same feature-focus control appears on both the home page and the feature-tour page via the shared nav.
responsive: The pill row wraps and the feature grid reflows so there is no horizontal overflow at 390px mobile or tablet.
The bar, pills and readout stay legible and correctly laid out across desktop, tablet and mobile.
regression: All existing sections are preserved: hero, pricing cards, Start Free Trial, contact ticket form, footer, theme toggle.
The dark-mode toggle and existing navigation continue to work unchanged.

author_notes: Native marketing lever: the startup landing page's OWN Main Features grid gains a "Feature focus" filter (All/Build/Design/Support pills + a live 'Showing N of 6' count) placed directly above the six feature cards — where a marketing site naturally hosts a feature filter, not a bolted-on metric strip. The same bar rides a manufactured feature-tour.html page for real cross-page continuity. Reuses local raster assets img/team-workflow.png and img/help-video-bg.png and the compiled css/output.css stylesheet plus the logo-light.svg image; the pill controls, card grid layout and dark-mode navy surfaces follow the existing Tailwind design system. Keywords: feature filter, focus pills, result count, mobile responsive wrap, dark mode, cross-page nav.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: Static single-page Tailwind startup landing template with a real six-card Main Features grid, a shared header nav and a #4a6cf7/navy design system, well-suited to a native feature-grid focus filter (ADD) reused across a manufactured feature-tour page, served statically without a build.
